meta.title: Delete Conversation
meta.description: Adds a Delete button beside Archive to permanently remove a conversation's local history after confirmation.

cleanupWarning: The conversation was deleted. An unrecognized historical shared cache was kept to protect other conversations.
description: Permanently removes this conversation's local messages, logs, caches and reminders. This cannot be undone. Running work will be stopped first.
filesNote: Project files in the working directory are kept. Independent branches and shared attachments are kept.
unsupported: This DSH version does not support safe deletion. See the plugin documentation.
